newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ERNST & YOUNG, S.AFRICAN FUND IN TALKS OVER DISPUTE.
newsitem.headline: ERNST & YOUNG, S.AFRICAN FUND IN TALKS OVER DISPUTE.

text.p: Ernst & Young said on Friday it was in final talks with the curators of the Masterbond group of companies in a bid to resolve disputes arising from the accountancy firm's position as statutory auditor to the failed investment concern.
"It is expected that a proposal will be put forward for the approval of investors and the sanction of the court within weeks," the companies said in a joint statement.
Both parties were agreed that it would be wrong to jeopardise the prospects of a settlement by issuing any further comment until the terms were finally agreed, the statement said.
Three Masterbond directors were found guilty of seven counts of fraud involving 129 million rand last October and were sentenced in the Cape Town Supreme Court to an effective 10 years in jail each.
The criminal activities of the Masterbond trio left many elderly people and pensioners in dire financial straits.
One pensioner committed siucide after the Masterbond crash and another testified that she had lost all her money and was now dependent on the state.
